recommended-action: Do not apply. Core requirement is an enterprise-level engineer with 5+ years in support/development/engineering/IT/QA and deep Red Hat Enterprise Linux expertise (installation, patch management, performance tuning, troubleshooting), plus configuration management, application deployment, and infrastructure orchestration. Candidate profile (frontend/solutions developer) has no Linux/RHEL, infrastructure, orchestration, or container experience and no adjacent path to bridge it. Remote-US-NC location and comp ($96,440-$154,190) are favorable, but the tech-stack and seniority mismatch is a hard blocker.
